column7: ExtendExpiringSecrets decided the project-wide expiry extension per secret only (enforceSecretWriteGate), so a project viewer holding a per-secret ACL write could extend those secrets through a direct core call while REST refused them (sibling of #4161 row 25). Core now calls requireScopedGate(secrets.write, project) before any secret is read or written; a refusal extends and audits nothing. Defence in depth: REST already refused and there is no gRPC method.
